sections.title: Zero to cut in three days

items.q: What is this 动态视频 actually selling?
items.a: Not the phone. The **set**. Team left Hangzhou. **Zero to cut in three days.** Six films this trip. Nancy: three or four on the mountain.

items.q: What does TIM think overseas reviewers do instead?
items.a: [[first-day-review-vs-slow-review]]. Wait **two to three months**, then ship a deep cut. He floats a thin 上手 now, the long piece later. **Not decided.**

items.q: Why is there a tiny robot arm in a room too small to walk?
items.a: [[reproduce-the-hero-path]]. Hero moves were drawn in Hangzhou. Talking-head cannot go back. The arm **packs in a case** and rematches the path so US A-roll cuts to the pre-shot.

items.q: How does that much kit leave China?
items.a: **ATA carnet.** Prove you will bring it home. Otherwise the pile stays.

items.q: What is the new tax versus prior years?
items.a: [[bilingual-same-day-ship]]. Chinese and English **leave together**. One show, **two recordings**. Translators sit in the villa. Not a subtitle pass.

items.q: Why are the director and producer cooking steak at night?
items.a: The house has a **shooting permit**, so it is on a mountain. Day unit. Night kitchen. The schedule is the location.

items.q: What is a grip truck, and what does it cost?
items.a: [[grip-truck-as-kit]]. A lighting-assistant van. Stands, sky cloths, the annoying parts. **$350 / ~¥2,000 a day.** Cheaper than TIM budgeted.
Hangzhou tag: after a long fight, the review **hit the date**. Tmall is the buy link, not the thesis.
